image_description: Two individuals standing outdoors on a grassy lawn wearing academic regalia. The person on the left wears a black gown with pink velvet panels and a mortarboard cap, holding a scroll. The person on the right wears a blue doctoral gown with three velvet bars on the sleeves and a soft tam cap. Both figures exhibit significant anatomical anomalies, particularly in the lower limbs and feet.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the upper bodies show gown-like structures, the garments do not drape naturally to the ankles; they appear to merge or terminate abruptly into malformed legs/feet.
The front openings of the gowns are visible and generally symmetrical on the torso.
The upper torsos are obscured by the heavy fabric as expected.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The distinctive wide sleeves characteristic of academic gowns are clearly visible on both subjects.
Velvet panels (pink and blue) are visible along the front edges.
The subject on the right appears to be barefoot with no visible trousers or shoes beneath the gown, violating the 'formal attire' context.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric texture appears consistent with heavy matte material.
Light interaction with the fabric is diffuse and non-reflective.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Sleeves hang correctly past the wrists.

artifact_observations.location: Lower legs and feet of both subjects
artifact_observations.reasoning: Catastrophic anatomical failure. The subject on the left has white leg coverings that look like fused boots/stumps with no defined feet. The subject on the right has distorted, fleshy protrusions instead of feet, appearing to melt into the grass.
The hands appear to merge with the scroll object; individual fingers are indistinguishable and structurally implausible.
Facial features are smeared and lack clear definition, typical of AI generation artifacts in small facial regions.
Slight warping in the vertical lines of the building columns in the background.
